RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_XILA_STRIKE.title: 打击
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_XILA_DEFEND.title: 防御
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_PELLET.title: 弹丸
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_PELLET.description: 对所有敌人造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。{IfUpgraded:show:\n给予所有敌人1层[gold]虚弱[/gold]。|}
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_PISTOL_SHOT.title: 手枪射击
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_PISTOL_SHOT.descriptio: {IfUpgraded:show:选择[gold]消耗[/gold]|随机[gold]消耗[/gold]} 1张牌\n将{Cards:diff()}张[gold]弹丸[/gold]放入手牌。
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_RELOAD.title: 重新装填
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_RELOAD.description: 将所有[gold]打击牌[/gold]放入[gold]手牌[/gold]，变化为{IfUpgraded:show:[green]弹丸+[/green]|[gold]弹丸[/gold]}。
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_MIXED_BOMB.title: 混合炸弹
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_MIXED_BOMB.description: 回合开始时对所有敌人造成{MixedBombPower:diff()}点伤害\n每当你给予一个敌人[gold]负面状态[/gold]时，使其受到{MixedBombPower:diff()}点伤害。
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_SEEK_COVER.title: 寻找掩护
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_SEEK_COVER.description: 获得{Block:diff()}点[gold]格挡[/gold]\n将1张{IfUpgraded:show:[green]弹丸+[/green]|[gold]弹丸[/gold]}放入手牌。
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_DAGGER_STRIKE.title: 匕首打击
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_DAGGER_STRIKE.descript: 造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害，将1张{IfUpgraded:show:[green]小刀+[/green]|[gold]小刀[/gold]}与{IfUpgraded:show:[green]弹丸+[/green]|[gold]弹丸[/gold]}放入手牌。
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_KNIFE_STORM.title: 飞刀风暴
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_KNIFE_STORM.descriptio: 将{Cards:diff()}张附魔灵巧[green]5[/green]的{IfUpgraded:show:[green]小刀+[/green]|[gold]小刀[/gold]}放入手牌。
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_BACKSTAB.title: 背刺
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_BACKSTAB.description: 造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害，如果敌人身上有[gold]易伤[/gold]，则伤害额外{IfUpgraded:show:增加75%|增加50%}。
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_HIDE.title: 隐遁
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_BERSERKER.title: 狂暴
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_BERSERKER.description: 在本回合内你[gold]手牌[/gold]中的所有[gold]攻击牌[/gold]耗能变为0\n本回合内不能再获得[gold]能量[/gold]。
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_AGILE_STEP.title: 灵动步法
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_AGILE_STEP.description: 获得4点[gold]临时敏捷[/gold]，持续{IfUpgraded:show:3|2}个回合。
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_FLAME_HOOK_PUNCH.title: 火焰勾拳
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_PIERCING_ARROW.title: 穿甲箭矢
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_PIERCING_ARROW.descrip: 去除敌人身上所有的[gold]格挡值[/gold]，造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_RABBIT_TRAP.title: 钓兔陷阱
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_RABBIT_TRAP.descriptio: 给予所有敌人{PoisonPower:diff()}层[gold]中毒[/gold]和{WeakPower:diff()}层[gold]虚弱[/gold]。
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_FIREPOWER_STRIKE.title: 火力打击
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_DARK_MOON_SLASH.title: 暗月斩击
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_DARK_MOON_SLASH.descri: 对所有敌人造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害。
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_SHADOW_WAVE.title: 暗影波动
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_SHADOW_WAVE.descriptio: 所有敌人在本回合失去{ShadowWavePower:diff()}点[gold]力量[/gold]。\n给予{WeakPower:diff()}层[gold]虚弱[/gold]。
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_SPIN_LEAP.title: 转体飞跃
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_SPIN_LEAP.description: 失去1点生命\n对所有敌人造成X次{Damage:diff()}点伤害。
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_NIGHT_DOMAIN.title: 黑夜领域
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_MOONLIGHT_GREATSWORD.d: 获得3点[gold]护卫[/gold]\n你打出的[gold]攻击牌[/gold]造成的伤害翻倍，敌人攻击对你造成的伤害翻倍。
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_MOONLIGHT_SHIELD.title: 女王武具·月光盾牌
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_MOONLIGHT_SHIELD.descr: 获得{IfUpgraded:show:8|5}点[gold]护卫[/gold]\n你打出的技能牌获得的[gold]格挡[/gold]翻倍，你打出的攻击牌造成的伤害降低50%。
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_MOONLIGHT_STAFF.title: 女王武具·月光法杖
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_MOONLIGHT_STAFF.descri: 获得{IfUpgraded:show:5|3}点[gold]护卫[/gold]\n所有敌人身上的[gold]虚弱[/gold]和[gold]易伤[/gold]的效果翻倍。
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_MOONLIGHT_BLADES.title: 女王武具·月光双刀
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_MOONLIGHT_BLADES.descr: 获得{IfUpgraded:show:4|2}点[gold]护卫[/gold]\n你每打出一张牌时,抽{IfUpgraded:show:[green]2[/green]|1}张牌。
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_QUEEN_AXE.title: 女王战斧·原初的战吼声
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_QUEEN_AXE.description: 在本回合内你打出的[gold]攻击牌[/gold]造成的伤害翻倍\n对全体敌人造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害，对所有敌人施加{VulnerablePower:diff()}层[gold]易伤[/gold]。
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_QUEEN_SPEAR.title: 女王长枪·迅捷的呼吸法
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_QUEEN_SPEAR.descriptio: 去除敌人身上所有的[gold]格挡值[/gold]和[gold]人工制品[/gold]\n造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害，并给予{VulnerablePower:diff()}层[gold]易伤[/gold]和{WeakPower:diff()}层[gold]虚弱[/gold]。
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_QUEEN_HARP.title: 女王竖琴·苍白的安魂曲
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_QUEEN_HARP.description: 你不能再切换女王武具\n在你的回合开始时，给予所有敌人1层[gold]易伤[/gold]和1层[gold]虚弱[/gold]，自身获得1点[gold]力量[/gold]和1点[gold]敏捷[/gold]。
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_QUEEN_FORM.title: 女王形态
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_QUEEN_FORM.description: 从{IfUpgraded:show:英雄决意+|英雄决意}和{IfUpgraded:show:邪咒再显+|邪咒再显}中选择一张加入手牌。
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_WIND_FIST.title: 疾风连拳
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_WIND_FIST.description: 造成{Damage:diff()}点伤害{IfUpgraded:show:3|2}次\n在本回合获得1点临时[gold]力量[/gold]。切换[gold]女王武具[/gold]时，将这张牌放入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_HERO_DETERMINATION.des: 每回合开始时获得{IfUpgraded:show:[green]15[/green]|10}点[gold]护卫[/gold]\n当你打出[gold]攻击牌[/gold]时，额外造成当前[gold]护卫值[/gold]的伤害。
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_CURSE_REVEAL.title: 邪咒再显
RAS_FOR_STS2_CARD_CURSE_REVEAL.descripti: 获得999层[gold]灾厄[/gold]\n将你的[gold]能量[/gold]恢复至上限，获得所有技能牌女王武具的效果。
